name: Visa-Free Entry / Tourist eVisa

qualifying_event.description: Oman exempts two groups of nationalities from a visa: a first group of 54 countries (most Western nations -- US, UK, Canada, Australia, France, Germany, Japan, etc.) plus GCC nationals (Bahrain, Kuwait, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, UAE), and a second group of 24 countries (including Algeria, Egypt, India, Jordan, Mexico, Morocco, Tunisia, Vietnam) who additionally must hold a valid US, Canadian, Australian, UK, Schengen, or Japanese visa, or GCC residency, to enter visa-free. All other nationalities need an eVisa or consular visa via the Royal Oman Police (ROP) eVisa system, e.g. the Tourist Visit Visa (Unsponsored).
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Valid passport; for second-group nationals, a valid visa from a named third country or GCC residence; for eVisa applicants, an online application through the ROP eVisa portal.

requirements.blocker_text: Nationals of the 54-country first group (most Western nations) or the GCC states may enter Oman without a visa, for a period of 14 days which cannot be extended or converted to a residence visa.

Nationals of the 24-country second group (e.g. Algeria, Egypt, India, Jordan, Mexico, Morocco, Tunisia, Vietnam) may enter visa-free for 14 days only if they hold a valid entry visa for the US, Canada, Australia, the UK, a Schengen country, or Japan, or GCC residency.
requirements.fix_path: Obtain a valid visa for the US, Canada, Australia, UK, Schengen area, or Japan, or GCC residency.

requirements.blocker_text: All other nationalities must obtain an eVisa (e.g. the unsponsored Tourist Visit Visa) or a consular visa through the Royal Oman Police eVisa system before travel.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for an eVisa via the ROP eVisa portal.

evidence_required.document: Third-country visa or GCC residency proof (group 2 nationals)

outcome.duration_length: 14 days for visa-exempt entry, non-extendable and not convertible to a residence visa; eVisa duration varies by type and was not confirmed in this pass

sources.title: Oman Ministry of Foreign Affairs -- entry visas: two-group visa-exemption structure, 14-day non-extendable stay for visa-exempt entrants, GCC exemption, second-group conditional exemption via third-country visas
Royal Oman Police -- official eVisa portal, confirms Tourist Visa as an eVisa category but did not surface a duration figure or full requirements list without an account login in this pass

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Oman).
